claim_boundary: Prospectively specified development comparison on structurally eligible same-day within-person four-word session-two trials, after source event structure was audited but before any session-two physiological feature extraction or scoring. Not independent confirmation of the earlier work; not cortical origin, cue-independent thoughts, arbitrary text, new-day robustness, unseen-person generalization, prospective live use or clinical utility. The fixed ordered signed bin means are not beta-envelope trajectories. No architecture ceiling is established by failure of this one representation.

fit_diagnostics.training_prior: outer-training add-one counts divided by ntrain+4
